description: Saves one of the user's kept asks ("Your asks") from the Flaim home page: adds a new ask, or edits the name and wording of one the user already kept, on the user's Flaim account. It is called by the Flaim home page and hidden from the model on hosts that support MCP Apps. It changes only the user's saved asks, never league data or anything on ESPN, Yahoo, or Sleeper.

id.description: The kept ask to edit. Leave it out to add a new ask.

label.description: The name the ask shows under in Your asks.

source_key.description: The Try asking prompt this ask replaces, as prompt:<n>, when it replaces one. Ignored on an edit.

text.description: The ask as the user wants it sent, without the "Using Flaim, " lead-in the page adds back.

name: save_flaim_home_ask
title: Keep an Ask
